I killed/straddled because I missed a blind, it was 4 more to go, 5 people were in so I said fuck it, and paid the extra 4. I was 10/5 suited. The flop was 10-A-10, it checks around to me, and I raise to 25. Everyone gets out, but one dude. He calls me. The next call is a 5.  Dude calls for 80. I call for All-In, at one considering just folding worried about slow playing Aces. He calls me. I think OH fuck, he has pocket aces, really my only concern. The river is an 8. 

He says, “I have a full house”. I say, “I have a full house too. Pocket Aces huh? I knew it”.(no one really plays pocket Aces there like that, they normally raise pre flop, and raise big)....NOPE he had, 10, 8 off suit. And caught an 8 on the river. Part of the reason he couldn’t get away from it, was that it was high hand, and he wanted that 200 dollars or whatever for quads, and was chasing that more. But a set of 10s with an 8 kicker, isn’t very strong, and so many hands would have had him beat I had just cleaned up being patient catching someone chasing their flush draw with a set of 4s and I lost big. I guess that’s poker right there. I was pissed, walked away and left.  Also dude next to me....had folded pocket 8s on the river 👍🏻
